reason: The hypothesis directly combines the finding that edge dislocations dominate plasticity in NbTaTiV (P3, P10) with the strategy of using coherent nanoprecipitates to enhance ductility in a tungsten alloy (P5), and proposes that deliberate solute additions can promote this edge-dislocation mechanism to improve toughness under fusion conditions. This is a synthesis of two distinct findings from different papers into a single mechanistic proposal for a new material system (W-based alloys) and a new application regime (fusion plasma-facing components), which none of the passages explicitly suggests.
